gear_plus.isekai_mahou.ability.smith.des: A burning shockwave hurts and ignites the enemies around the target.
gear_plus.isekai_mahou.ability.rogue.des: An extra cut on the target; you vanish for a moment and run faster.
gear_plus.isekai_mahou.ability.knight.de: The target staggers and you gain a shield and resistance for a few seconds.
gear_plus.isekai_mahou.ability.quincy.de: Arrows of light fall on the 3 enemies closest to the target.
gear_plus.isekai_mahou.ability.gunslinge: The shot bounces to up to 3 other enemies nearby.
gear_plus.isekai_mahou.ability.ranger.de: The prey is slowed and exposed; you gain speed.
gear_plus.isekai_mahou.ability.gambler.d: One of three prizes: a double hit, healing or energy back.
gear_plus.isekai_mahou.ability.steelball: The target is launched and dazed; enemies nearby are pushed away.

tooltip.isekai_mahou.gear_plus.chisel: With the chisel on the cursor, right-click a piece of equipment to take out its last gem intact.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.gear_plus.sockets.d: Dormant gems: they only work for Smiths, Rune Knights or Enchanters.
